summary: Backend-only testing of /api/v2 workspace read API + /api/v2/workspaces + auth regression. 31/31 pytest tests pass against the public preview URL. Covered: overview shape, memory list/filter(category,q)/detail, attention default/later, categories (6 w/ n+count), people list(5)/detail, timeline list/detail, sources list(3: gmail/slack/notes)/detail (threads+candidates+learned), reviews list(2)/detail (proposals+trigger+compared), threads list(4)/detail (messages), ask POST (id,question,answer,confidence,sources,at) + history, thread draft/send, action stubs (seen/snooze/dismiss/review accept/conflict resolve/source sync all {ok:true}), /api/v2/workspaces includes seeded p1+p2 for authenticated pro user, auth regression (OTP request+verify, /api/auth/me, /api/auth/logout).

minor.issue: SendIn.to is typed as str (not list[str]); the review spec's example {body,to:[...]} would 422. Minor contract/typing mismatch — if the UI already sends a string this is fine, otherwise widen to Union[str, list[str]].

action_items: (Optional) Widen /threads/{tid}/send `to` field to accept list[str] in addition to str to match the review-request contract example.
critical_code_review_comments: v2_workspace.py: per-workspace endpoints intentionally ignore `wid` and always return the same seed fixture — fine for this phase but worth adding a comment/validation when real DB-backed data lands.
Draft and ask answers are hardcoded strings; make sure UI copy guards against stale canned responses when AI integration ships.
File is ~400 lines, within limits; no MongoDB _id leakage observed in v2 responses.
seed_data_creation: none; relied on existing seed fixture served by v2_workspace._seed()
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_v2_workspace.py covers all v2 workspace read endpoints + /api/v2/workspaces + auth regression (31 tests, all green). Backend auth endpoints live under /api/auth/* (not /auth/*). Note SendIn.to typing is `str`, not `list`.
